source.description.zh-Hans: 瓜子漫画的热门榜以国漫长篇为主，能找到《从姑获鸟开始》《原来，她们才是主角》等作品。书库还按男频、女频分区。
source.description.zh-Hant: 瓜子漫畫的熱門榜以中國長篇漫畫為主，能找到《從姑獲鳥開始》《原來，她們才是主角》等作品。書庫另按男頻、女頻分區。
source.description.en: Guazi's popularity charts feature long-running Chinese comics, including Cong Guhuo Niao Kaishi and It Turns Out, They Were the Protagonists. Its catalogue also groups titles by intended audience.
